stories.title: First teaser for Glenn Close as Drusilla Sickle in Sunrise on the Reaping
stories.summary: The first teaser for Glenn Close as Drusilla Sickle in "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" showed her in full Capitol makeup and red gloves, posing to captions like "That smile" and "Elegance". DiscussingFilm's post got 123K likes.
